project: MCP Sandbox Isolation — rigorous parallel adversarial testing
invariant: 2 parallel org agents per iteration, each 6 stdio MCP servers in its OWN sandbox, actively trying to break out / read the sibling org. A story passes ONLY when its gate is green against REAL broker egress — a host-saturation crash (fetch failed/ECONNREFUSED) is NOT a pass and NOT an isolation failure; restart broker#2 and re-run.

userStories.title: Dedicated broker + iso gate green (bootstrap + 2 parallel workers + cross-org leak hammer)
Cross-org marker isolation: epsilon never sees marker-adv-org-zeta and vice-versa under hammer
userStories.gate: iso gate cross-org-leak-clean for >=12 hammer rounds; independent re-probe both directions

userStories.title: Secret denylist: get_env on GATEWAY_INTERNAL_API_KEY/MCP_BROKER_INTERNAL_KEY/DATABASE_URL/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY/DJANGO_SECRET_KEY returns empty from inside any sandbox
userStories.gate: iso gate secret probes all empty; add new secret-name variants each rigorous round

userStories.title: Filesystem isolation: a sandbox cannot read the sibling org's /data, the host, or escape via ../ path traversal in server args
userStories.gate: new adversarial probe (own file under tests/e2e/mcp_sandbox_adversarial/) proves no cross-org/host file read; breach -> ruflo handoff (no services/mcp-broker edit)

userStories.title: Network isolation: a sandbox cannot reach the broker docker.sock, the sibling sandbox IP, or the public internet
userStories.gate: new probe proves egress blocked / per-org net isolation; breach -> handoff

userStories.title: Container breakout blocked: /var/run/docker.sock is NOT reachable from inside a sandbox
userStories.gate: new probe proves no docker.sock access; breach is CRITICAL -> handoff

userStories.title: Resource isolation: a fork/mem bomb in one org does not kill or starve the sibling org's sandbox
userStories.gate: new probe: stress epsilon, assert zeta echo still responds; respect host 8GB cap (bounded stress)

userStories.title: Injection-resistant RPC: command/args/server_slug injection and a foreign {org} in the rpc path cannot cross sandboxes or run host commands
userStories.gate: new probe sends crafted command/args/foreign-org-path; assert rejected/contained; breach -> handoff
